arguments.cypher_query:
MATCH (ms:Disease {name: "Multiple Sclerosis"})<-[:RELATED_TO]-(d:Disease)
RETURN d.name AS related_disease, count(*) AS frequency
ORDER BY frequency DESC
LIMIT 30
